title: Private Sailing Charter on San Diego Bay
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A maximum of 6 people per booking
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: San Diego Bay is one of the most beautiful bodies of water on the West Coast of the United States. Why not enjoy this natural wonder aboard a beautiful sailing yacht with a knowledgeable and friendly Captain? This private charter includes the yacht plus Captain for your exclusive use.  It's your vessel and you determine the itinerary.  See detailed description for itinerary ideas or make up your own. You can participate in sailing the vessel as much or as little as you like. Complimentary bottled water, and snacks are included or bring your own food and drink (no red wine please).
